source.name: QuantJourney Backtester example strategies
source.license: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE in the repository; the repository has no NOTICE file)
source.framing: The X post that linked quants.md called it a leaked Jane Street library. That is false: it is QuantJourney's public Apache-2.0 example collection.

strategies.name: Market SMA Crossover
strategies.summary: Buy SMA(20) crossing above SMA(50), sell on reverse
strategies.rules: Per ETF: buy about 18% of equity at market when SMA 20 moves above SMA 50; sell all at market when it moves back below.
strategies.costs: 5.0 bp slippage; $0.005/share commission (min $1.0)

strategies.name: Market RSI Reversion
strategies.summary: Buy RSI(14) < 35, sell RSI > 60
strategies.rules: Per ETF: buy about 12% of equity at market while RSI 14 is below 35; sell all when RSI 14 rises above 60.
strategies.costs: 5.0 bp slippage; 1.0 bp commission

strategies.name: Limit RSI Dip Buyer
strategies.summary: Passive buy-limit below the close on weak RSI
strategies.rules: Per ETF: when RSI 14 is below 40, place a buy limit 1.5% under the close (valid 3 bars); once long, place a sell limit 3% over the average entry (valid 3 bars).
strategies.costs: 3.0 bp slippage; 1.0 bp commission

strategies.name: Limit Trend Pullback
strategies.rebalance: Limit on 1% pullback, fill at open
strategies.summary: In an uptrend, wait for a 1% pullback to enter
strategies.rules: Per ETF: when the close is above SMA 50, place a buy limit 1% under the close (valid 2 bars); take profit with a sell limit 4% over entry; sell at market if the close falls under SMA 50.
strategies.costs: 3.0 bp slippage; 1.0 bp commission

strategies.name: Stop Breakout Entry
strategies.summary: Buy-stop above the recent 20-day high
strategies.rules: Per ETF: place a buy stop 0.2% over the highest close of the prior 20 bars (valid 5 bars); sell at market 10 bars after the fill.
strategies.costs: 5.0 bp slippage; $0.005/share commission (min $1.0)

strategies.name: Protective Stop Loss
strategies.summary: Trend entry with a 5% protective stop
strategies.rules: Per ETF: buy about 15% of equity at market when SMA 20 moves above SMA 50; attach a stop 5% under entry; sell at market when SMA 20 moves back below SMA 50.
strategies.costs: 5.0 bp slippage; $0.005/share commission (min $1.0)

dsl.name: QJ O06 SMA cross with 5% stop
dsl.description: Up-cross entry, down-cross or 5% stop exit.

strategies.name: Stop-Limit Breakout
strategies.summary: Enter breakouts but cap the maximum fill price
strategies.rules: Per ETF: buy stop 0.2% over the prior 20-bar high with a limit 0.4% over the stop (valid 5 bars), so a gap can leave it unfilled; sell at market 12 bars after the fill.
strategies.costs: 4.0 bp slippage; 1.0 bp commission

strategies.name: Stop-Limit Protection
strategies.summary: Trend entry, downside protected by a stop-limit sell
strategies.rules: As O06, but the protective exit is a stop-limit (stop 4% under entry, limit 4.5% under entry), which can stay unfilled after a gap.
strategies.costs: 5.0 bp slippage; $0.005/share commission (min $1.0)

strategies.name: Trailing Stop Trend
strategies.summary: Trend entry, 4% trailing stop manages the exit
strategies.rules: Per ETF: SMA 20/50 trend entry at market; exit with a 4% trailing stop or at market on the reverse cross.
strategies.costs: 5.0 bp slippage; $0.005/share commission (min $1.0)

strategies.name: RSI + Trailing Stop
strategies.summary: Oversold RSI entry, 5% trailing stop for risk
strategies.rules: Per ETF: buy at market when RSI 14 is below 38; exit with a 5% trailing stop or at market when RSI 14 is above 65.
strategies.costs: 5.0 bp slippage; 1.0 bp commission

strategies.name: Trailing Stop-Limit
strategies.rebalance: Trailing stop that converts to a limit
strategies.summary: Trailing stop that converts to a limit on trigger
strategies.rules: As O09, but the trailing exit is a trailing stop-limit (trail 4% of the close, limit 0.5% under the stop).
strategies.costs: 5.0 bp slippage; 1.0 bp commission

strategies.name: Bracket Trend
strategies.summary: Trend entry with a +6% / −3% bracket
strategies.rules: Per ETF: on the SMA 20/50 up-cross, buy at market with a bracket: take profit 6% and stop 3% from the signal close; sell at market on the reverse cross.
strategies.costs: 5.0 bp slippage; $0.005/share commission (min $1.0)

dsl.name: QJ O12 SMA cross bracket 6/3
dsl.description: Up-cross entry; 6% target, 3% stop, down-cross exit.

strategies.name: Bracket RSI Reversion
strategies.summary: RSI dip with a +4% / −2% bracket
strategies.rules: Per ETF: buy when RSI 14 is below 35 with a bracket: take profit 4% and stop 2% from the signal close; sell at market when RSI 14 is above 70.
strategies.costs: 5.0 bp slippage; 1.0 bp commission

dsl.name: QJ O13 RSI bracket 4/2
dsl.description: RSI 14 < 35 entry; 4% target, 2% stop, RSI 14 > 70 exit.

strategies.name: OCO Dip or Breakout
strategies.summary: Competing buy-limit (dip) and buy-stop (breakout)
strategies.rules: Per ETF, every 5th bar while flat: a one-cancels-other pair of a buy limit 2% under and a buy stop 2% over the close (valid 5 bars); sell at market 10 bars after the fill.
strategies.costs: 5.0 bp slippage; $0.005/share commission (min $1.0)

strategies.name: Intraday 5m Bracket Reversion
strategies.summary: Oversold-RSI dips with a tight +0.6% / −0.4% bracket; 5-min bars
strategies.rules: 5-minute bars: buy when RSI 14 is below 30 with a bracket of +0.6% take profit and -0.4% stop.
strategies.costs: 2.0 bp slippage; $0.005/share commission (min $1.0)

rerun.reason: Yahoo serves 5-minute bars only for the last 60 days (checked 2026-10-31); the published window 2026-06-10 to 2026-07-11 is outside it, and Vertex stores no intraday history.

strategies.name: Intraday 30m Stop Breakout
strategies.summary: Buy-stop above the 12-bar high, fixed holding period; 30-min bars
strategies.rules: 30-minute bars: buy stop over the prior 12-bar high (valid 3 bars); sell at market after a fixed number of bars.
strategies.costs: 2.0 bp slippage; $0.005/share commission (min $1.0)

rerun.reason: Yahoo serves 30-minute bars only for the last 60 days (checked 2026-10-31); the published window 2026-05-18 to 2026-07-10 is outside it, and Vertex stores no intraday history.

strategies.name: Monthly Rotation (orders)
strategies.summary: Event-driven monthly momentum rotation, executed with orders
strategies.rules: On the first bar of each month, rank 8 multi-asset ETFs by 6-month return; sell names that left the top set and buy new entrants at market, equal value per name.
strategies.costs: 3.0 bp slippage; $0.005/share commission (min $1.0)

strategies.name: Signal-Change Rotation (orders)
strategies.summary: Trade only on SMA trend-signal flips (no calendar)
strategies.rules: Per ETF: trade only on SMA 20/50 signal changes: buy at market on a flat-to-long change, sell on a long-to-flat change; no calendar rebalance.
strategies.costs: 3.0 bp slippage; $0.005/share commission (min $1.0)

dsl.name: QJ O18 SMA 20/50 signal change
dsl.description: Long on the SMA 20/50 up-cross, flat on the down-cross.

strategies.name: FX Momentum with Standard Lots
strategies.summary: Contract-aware whole-lot momentum on USD-quoted spot pairs
strategies.rules: Four USD-quoted FX pairs: long or short in the direction of the 126-bar return, in whole 100,000-unit lots sized by 0.5% equity risk per ATR 20 and a 20% notional cap per pair.
strategies.costs: 0.5 bp slippage; 0.1 bp commission

strategies.name: Futures Donchian Contracts
strategies.summary: Whole-contract ATR sizing on provider continuous futures
strategies.rules: Four continuous futures: long above the prior 55-bar high, short below the prior 55-bar low, otherwise keep the side; whole contracts sized by 0.5% equity risk per ATR 20 and a 25% notional cap.
strategies.costs: 1.0 bp slippage

strategies.name: Daily SMA Trend
strategies.summary: Hold each sector ETF while SMA(50) > SMA(200); daily rebalance
strategies.rules: Daily: hold each sector ETF while SMA 50 is above SMA 200, equal weight across the active names, at most 25% each; otherwise cash.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Monthly ETF Trend + Drift
strategies.summary: SMA(50/200) trend on ETFs; month-end + 5% drift band
strategies.rules: Hold each multi-asset ETF while SMA 50 is above SMA 200 (at most 30% each); rebalance at month end or when a weight drifts more than 5 percentage points.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Weekly RSI Reversion
strategies.summary: Enter RSI(14) < 35, exit RSI > 60; weekly (Fri)
strategies.rules: Per sector ETF: become long when RSI 14 is below 35 and stay long until RSI 14 is above 60; equal weight across long names (at most 25%); rebalance on Fridays.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

dsl.name: QJ W03 RSI reversion 35/60
dsl.description: Long from RSI 14 < 35 until RSI 14 > 60 (daily, not weekly).

strategies.name: Quarterly Dual Momentum
strategies.summary: Rank ETFs by 12-month return, hold top 2 if positive; quarter-end
strategies.rules: At each quarter end, rank 8 multi-asset ETFs by 252-bar return and hold the top 2 that have a positive return, equal weight; otherwise cash.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Monthly Inverse Volatility
strategies.summary: Size each ETF by inverse 63-day volatility; month-end
strategies.rules: At each month end, weight 8 multi-asset ETFs by the inverse of their 63-bar volatility (at most 35% each).
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Signal-Change Defensive Rotation
strategies.summary: SPY > SMA(200) → risk-on ETFs, else defensive; on signal change
strategies.rules: When SPY closes above its SMA 200 hold the risk ETFs, otherwise the defensive ETFs; trade only when the regime changes.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Intraday RSI 15m
strategies.summary: Equal-weight basket when RSI oversold; 15-minute bars
strategies.rules: 15-minute bars: equal weight in names whose RSI 14 is below 35 until RSI 14 is above 55; trade on signal changes.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

rerun.reason: Yahoo serves 15-minute bars only for the last 60 days (checked 2026-10-31); the published window 2026-06-19 to 2026-07-11 is outside it, and Vertex stores no intraday history.

strategies.name: Intraday EMA Scalp 1m
strategies.summary: EMA(9/21) trend/cash; 1-minute bars
strategies.rules: 1-minute bars: hold each name while EMA 9 is above EMA 21; trade on signal changes.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

rerun.reason: Yahoo serves 1-minute bars only for the last 30 days (checked 2026-10-31); the published window 2026-07-05 to 2026-07-11 is outside it, and Vertex stores no intraday history.

strategies.name: Intraday SMA Trend 1h
strategies.summary: SMA(10/30) trend/cash; hourly bars
strategies.rules: Hourly bars: hold each name while SMA 10 is above SMA 30, equal weight across active names (at most 25%); trade on signal changes.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

dsl.name: QJ W09 hourly SMA 10/30 trend
dsl.description: Long while SMA 10 > SMA 30 on hourly bars.

strategies.name: Monthly + Circuit Breaker
strategies.summary: Monthly ETF trend; flatten on a 15% drawdown + cooldown
strategies.rules: Monthly SMA 50/200 trend on 8 multi-asset ETFs; if the portfolio draws down 15% go to cash for a 10-day cooldown.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Quarterly TE + Cost Gate
strategies.summary: Momentum with tracking-error trigger and turnover budget
strategies.rules: Quarterly momentum rotation on 8 multi-asset ETFs; rebalance early when the 63-day tracking error to SPY exceeds 6%; skip trades once a rolling 252-day turnover budget of 4x is spent.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Daily Partial Drift
strategies.summary: Momentum tilt; trade only names past a 10% drift band
strategies.rules: Daily momentum tilt across the sector ETFs; trade only the names whose weight drifted more than 10% from target (partial rebalance).
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Pairs Trading (Ratio Z-Score)
strategies.summary: Market-neutral KO/PEP on a log-ratio z-score
strategies.rules: KO/PEP pair: z-score of log(KO) - log(PEP) over 60 bars; short the rich leg and long the cheap leg at |z| > 2 (0.5 each); flat at |z| < 0.5.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Pairs Trading (Hedge Ratio)
strategies.summary: Market-neutral EWA/EWC on a rolling OLS hedge-ratio spread
strategies.rules: EWA/EWC pair: spread from a rolling hedge ratio (covariance over variance of the logs); same z-score entry 2 and exit 0.5; legs 0.5 each.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Cross-Sectional Momentum (L/S)
strategies.summary: Long top-3 / short bottom-3 by 12-month return; monthly
strategies.rules: Month end: rank sector ETFs by 252-bar return; long the top 3 (+0.5 total) and short the bottom 3 (-0.5 total).
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Cross-Sectional Reversal (L/S)
strategies.summary: Long losers / short winners by 1-month return; weekly
strategies.rules: Fridays: rank sector ETFs by 21-bar return; long the 3 biggest losers and short the 3 biggest winners (0.5 gross each side).
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Vol-Targeted Trend
strategies.summary: SMA trend basket scaled to a 10% volatility target
strategies.rules: SMA 50/200 trend basket on 8 multi-asset ETFs, scaled to 10% annual volatility (63-bar estimate, at most 1.5x); month-end rebalance.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Vol-Targeted Momentum
strategies.summary: Momentum basket scaled to a 15% volatility target
strategies.rules: Top names by 126-bar return among 8 multi-asset ETFs, scaled to 15% annual volatility (42-bar estimate, at most 2x); month-end rebalance.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Risk Parity (Multi-Asset ERC)
strategies.summary: Equal risk contribution across a multi-asset basket
strategies.rules: All 8 multi-asset ETFs with equal risk contribution from a 63-bar covariance; month-end rebalance.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Risk Parity + Position Cap
strategies.summary: Sector ERC chained with a 25% per-position cap
strategies.rules: Equal risk contribution across the sector ETFs from a 126-bar covariance, then each weight capped at 25% and renormalized; month-end rebalance.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Bollinger Band Reversion
strategies.summary: Buy below the lower band, exit at the midline
strategies.rules: Per sector ETF: buy when the close is under the lower Bollinger band (SMA 20 - 2 standard deviations); exit when the close is over SMA 20; equal weight, at most 25%.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: MACD Trend
strategies.summary: Long while MACD is above its signal line
strategies.rules: Per sector ETF: hold while the MACD line (EMA 12 - EMA 26) is above its EMA 9 signal line; equal weight, at most 25%.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: FX Time-Series Momentum
strategies.summary: Six-month trend across USD-quoted spot pairs; inverse-vol weights
strategies.rules: Four USD-quoted FX pairs: long or short in the direction of the 126-bar return, weighted by inverse 63-bar volatility; month-end rebalance; price return only.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: FX Cross-Sectional Momentum
strategies.summary: Long strongest / short weakest XXX/USD pair; monthly
strategies.rules: Month end: rank four USD-quoted FX pairs by 63-bar return; long the strongest and short the weakest (gross 1, net 0); price return only.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Continuous Futures Trend Proxy
strategies.summary: Diversified long/short trend on provider continuous series
strategies.rules: Six continuous futures: long or short by trend direction with inverse-volatility weights; month-end rebalance; price-return proxy, no multipliers or roll costs.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Rolling Walk-Forward
strategies.summary: Sliding fixed-length train/test windows with a pre-OOS purge
strategies.rules: Validation of the W01-style SMA 50/200 sector trend (month-end rebalance) with a rolling walk-forward: fixed-length train and test windows and a purge gap before each test window.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Expanding Walk-Forward
strategies.summary: Ever-growing training window vs sliding test window
strategies.rules: The same SMA 50/200 sector trend validated with an expanding walk-forward: the train window grows from a fixed start.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Anchored + Pre-OOS Purging
strategies.summary: Fixed and percentage-based exclusions before each test window
strategies.rules: Weekly RSI sector reversion validated with an anchored walk-forward and a fixed plus percentage purge before each test window.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Grid Search
strategies.summary: Exhaustive SMA fast/slow tuning scored by real backtests
strategies.rules: Grid search of SMA fast/slow windows (3 x 3 = 9 candidates) for the sector trend, each scored by its backtest Sharpe.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional

strategies.name: Optuna TPE + Walk-Forward
strategies.summary: Bayesian parameter search, then out-of-sample validation
strategies.rules: Optuna TPE search of SMA fast/slow windows (fast < slow), then a rolling walk-forward of the best pair.
strategies.costs: engine default 1 bp per traded notional
